requirements.what: Correctable meals with exactly three temporal precision values, real host media interpretation, estimated photo nutrients and participant-selected reminders.

meal_contract.exact: Timezone-bearing occurred_at; no occurred_date; explicit time_precision exact is optional for compatibility.
meal_contract.day: time_precision day and occurred_date YYYY-MM-DD; supplied or current participant timezone is preserved; no occurred_at.
meal_contract.unknown: Neither occurred_at nor occurred_date; no dated reminder suppression.
meal_contract.nutrients: photo_estimate source_kind and nutrient_certainty estimate are separate from temporal precision.

requirements.remaining_regression: Correction from current-day meal to previous-day or unknown must correctly rearm only an eligible never-sent cancelled reminder. Separate patch/regression is not verified by the 115-test baseline.
